description.value:
Your bond with the Force manifests as an array of force powers you can call upon, governed by the general forcecasting rules and drawn from the force powers list.

Force Powers Known. You start knowing 4 force powers of your choice, gaining additional ones as you rise in level per the Force Powers Known column of the Beguiler Practice Forcecasting table. You can't learn a power whose level exceeds your current Max Power Level, and you're allowed to pick up a power and its prerequisite together.

Force Points. Your pool of force points equals your operative level, as tracked in the Force Points column of the Beguiler Practice Forcecasting table, plus your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (whichever you prefer). Casting a power spends these points, and a long rest restores the whole pool.

Max Power Level. Certain force powers can be pushed further by overpowering them, spending extra points for a stronger effect; the ceiling for this rises with level, per the Max Power Level column of the table. You can only overpower a power to 4th level once between long rests.

Forcecasting Ability. Which ability governs your casting depends on the power's alignment: Wisdom for light-side powers, Charisma for dark-side powers, and your choice of either for universal powers. This same ability applies whenever a power references your forcecasting ability, and it sets both your save DC and your attack bonus with force powers.

Force save DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your forcecasting ability modifier

Force attack modifier = your proficiency bonus + your forcecasting ability modifier
